body.name: Observable exact-close diagnostic protocol
body.construction: Construct \(\mathcal D_n\) by reporting, for every \(j\in\mathcal J\), the joint confidence region for \(s_{j,n}\), the numerical calibration residual \(\widehat s_{j,n}\), any documented ex ante algebraic calibration to known administrative population totals, held-out pre-period change residuals not included in \(G_{ri}\), balance for prespecified omitted-risk summaries, the maximum donor weight \(\max_{r\in\mathcal R}\omega_{jr}\), and group effective sample sizes. Absence of documented population-total calibration is reported rather than replaced by ranked sample near-balance.
